A high heart rate after drinking alcohol is common and ` [Highlight start] usually happens because alcohol stimulates your nervous system, widens blood vessels, and causes dehydration [Highlight end] ` . For light to moderate drinking, a racing heart typically settles within 4 to 12 hours as your body clears the alcohol and rehydrates.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF18ueOb4Et9eKIPnP_018XyQ9vzTuiB3Tq7SX5mmEoW_th_IPQ5L6PYoDoj13DywI0P8Nj2TMJ7V-SKwc-dOrKj-waGRmsXd200kHnhwVHPytk4vGOFsauaxIyklBpbHBZjomjs0syxwqWRWdNO18YRXO3yBMvZnxNNG0N1cB9ur84CC9g4KhdRlOSPH3f8XMous5iQo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXq3UfvY3rfhneto2b6RKBoSvDg0zvw3sNuGhLvMAkVrNObFnYMTYlJc9sMflbbnGbup6fJ6RENFdDS9i2LbFziXLN8wFQW51c9qir3sPslmsIB4qiPis59Fe8XZHI8Nrw8ein8Fy4mw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXaRzFf1uVuh-zf73IxdplrY4oe4g_rwfwfCUgTOEo6uCtVhMNcztfaFxBckkxpoaUgrat-wu4ZWpKGu6WiXErGBwewOGSyYDvK6i-So2ef4T8MxXac8XK0R8VxYuff8jU)

### Common Causes

- **Nervous system & adrenaline:** Alcohol suppresses calming signals and activates stress responses, raising your pulse and reducing heart rate variability.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF18ueOb4Et9eKIPnP_018XyQ9vzTuiB3Tq7SX5mmEoW_th_IPQ5L6PYoDoj13DywI0P8Nj2TMJ7V-SKwc-dOrKj-waGRmsXd200kHnhwVHPytk4vGOFsauaxIyklBpbHBZjomjs0syxwqWRWdNO18YRXO3yBMvZnxNNG0N1cB9ur84CC9g4KhdRlOSPH3f8XMous5iQo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXq3UfvY3rfhneto2b6RKBoSvDg0zvw3sNuGhLvMAkVrNObFnYMTYlJc9sMflbbnGbup6fJ6RENFdDS9i2LbFziXLN8wFQW51c9qir3sPslmsIB4qiPis59Fe8XZHI8Nrw8ein8Fy4mw)
- **Dehydration & blood vessel changes:** Alcohol acts as a diuretic and widens blood vessels, making your heart pump faster to circulate blood and maintain pressure.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF15GmeJ6sc2kivRRSe-NMu7e_etkp6e9EKJCZcxJPYtGhL9ua2Ta_A00Sekl3rTa61woyar1vOlSQqvCGwIuJohAv2kMc960xfMdQ3zUaSHq-kNHSriJvyo0y2RoRXlNQObV86MqP_QORBid2q2-fFtbusOEKoH981MgG1FRq-BwEln77YKubIFO_ng)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF18ueOb4Et9eKIPnP_018XyQ9vzTuiB3Tq7SX5mmEoW_th_IPQ5L6PYoDoj13DywI0P8Nj2TMJ7V-SKwc-dOrKj-waGRmsXd200kHnhwVHPytk4vGOFsauaxIyklBpbHBZjomjs0syxwqWRWdNO18YRXO3yBMvZnxNNG0N1cB9ur84CC9g4KhdRlOSPH3f8XMous5iQo)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXaRzFf1uVuh-zf73IxdplrY4oe4g_rwfwfCUgTOEo6uCtVhMNcztfaFxBckkxpoaUgrat-wu4ZWpKGu6WiXErGBwewOGSyYDvK6i-So2ef4T8MxXac8XK0R8VxYuff8jU)
- **Rebound anxiety ("hangxiety"):** As alcohol wears off, nervous system rebound can trigger restlessness, anxiety, and a faster heartbeat.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF18ueOb4Et9eKIPnP_018XyQ9vzTuiB3Tq7SX5mmEoW_th_IPQ5L6PYoDoj13DywI0P8Nj2TMJ7V-SKwc-dOrKj-waGRmsXd200kHnhwVHPytk4vGOFsauaxIyklBpbHBZjomjs0syxwqWRWdNO18YRXO3yBMvZnxNNG0N1cB9ur84CC9g4KhdRlOSPH3f8XMous5iQo)
- **Arrhythmias ("holiday heart syndrome"):** Heavy or binge drinking—and sometimes smaller amounts in sensitive individuals—can trigger irregular rhythms like atrial fibrillation (AFib) within 24 to 48 hours.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF13rwqEG3J2h-xF9F_jHN8-eWDyCxpq1nbEiTYjBCPpTCJ_uFtdQ26hO90gsZFIwnSDW-EO8sJso9J1f1Dixx5D5XE05QWWTCmfrshD8HCNAm8yHm3KBQhomSSOjOmRFryV5ZVD0dK9Appt9-OSpYczVLtaEyMztKRORgWQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXLvHTlBHDtw4tX4zUmRNVfVTvGCQzmSYgJCurhQR0mFJv1K24Cm8tgf_XX-yDerPuWRq2xX7DUVUzedMjWD3OeL8f2Dtq7H70xrW3CK5ftU4bJdEbjmsZbGUWmj5Jx4ae)
- **Alcohol withdrawal:** In regular or heavy drinkers, a fast pulse appearing 6 to 24 hours after stopping—especially with sweating, tremors, or severe anxiety—can signal early withdrawal.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF18ueOb4Et9eKIPnP_018XyQ9vzTuiB3Tq7SX5mmEoW_th_IPQ5L6PYoDoj13DywI0P8Nj2TMJ7V-SKwc-dOrKj-waGRmsXd200kHnhwVHPytk4vGOFsauaxIyklBpbHBZjomjs0syxwqWRWdNO18YRXO3yBMvZnxNNG0N1cB9ur84CC9g4KhdRlOSPH3f8XMous5iQo)

### What You Can Do Now (For Mild Symptoms)

- **Rehydrate:** Sip water or an electrolyte drink to counter fluid and electrolyte loss.
- **Slow your breathing:** Try slow, deep breaths or a vagal maneuver (like gentle paced breathing) to help calm your nervous system.
- **Rest and avoid extra stimulants:** Skip caffeine or strenuous exertion while your heart rate is elevated.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF18ueOb4Et9eKIPnP_018XyQ9vzTuiB3Tq7SX5mmEoW_th_IPQ5L6PYoDoj13DywI0P8Nj2TMJ7V-SKwc-dOrKj-waGRmsXd200kHnhwVHPytk4vGOFsauaxIyklBpbHBZjomjs0syxwqWRWdNO18YRXO3yBMvZnxNNG0N1cB9ur84CC9g4KhdRlOSPH3f8XMous5iQo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF13rwqEG3J2h-xF9F_jHN8-eWDyCxpq1nbEiTYjBCPpTCJ_uFtdQ26hO90gsZFIwnSDW-EO8sJso9J1f1Dixx5D5XE05QWWTCmfrshD8HCNAm8yHm3KBQhomSSOjOmRFryV5ZVD0dK9Appt9-OSpYczVLtaEyMztKRORgWQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF15GmeJ6sc2kivRRSe-NMu7e_etkp6e9EKJCZcxJPYtGhL9ua2Ta_A00Sekl3rTa61woyar1vOlSQqvCGwIuJohAv2kMc960xfMdQ3zUaSHq-kNHSriJvyo0y2RoRXlNQObV86MqP_QORBid2q2-fFtbusOEKoH981MgG1FRq-BwEln77YKubIFO_ng)

### When to Seek Care

- **Emergency care (call 911 or go to the ER):** Seek immediate help for chest pain or pressure, severe shortness of breath, fainting, dizziness, confusion, a heart rate that stays very high or irregular and will not settle, or seizures.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF18ueOb4Et9eKIPnP_018XyQ9vzTuiB3Tq7SX5mmEoW_th_IPQ5L6PYoDoj13DywI0P8Nj2TMJ7V-SKwc-dOrKj-waGRmsXd200kHnhwVHPytk4vGOFsauaxIyklBpbHBZjomjs0syxwqWRWdNO18YRXO3yBMvZnxNNG0N1cB9ur84CC9g4KhdRlOSPH3f8XMous5iQo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXX4-9uZcnNAXxMuxCJjJ2exZJUM_xxaDKZ2K8XCOqzpZEkHFgDtE5GpbI2wCIfPm088S5kt03fuPylxMmMZuIh2cd-kaoo7vd5H0fwxdH7MApYZ6hHoOwLAdCzK6ny1Wk4vEwjEbU)
- **See a doctor:** Schedule a medical visit if palpitations or a fast heart rate keep happening after drinking, if you suspect alcohol withdrawal, or if you have underlying heart or blood pressure issues. For more on how to calm a racing pulse and reduce future risk, see [Verywell Health](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF15GmeJ6sc2kivRRSe-NMu7e_etkp6e9EKJCZcxJPYtGhL9ua2Ta_A00Sekl3rTa61woyar1vOlSQqvCGwIuJohAv2kMc960xfMdQ3zUaSHq-kNHSriJvyo0y2RoRXlNQObV86MqP_QORBid2q2-fFtbusOEKoH981MgG1FRq-BwEln77YKubIFO_ng) and [Cleveland Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF13rwqEG3J2h-xF9F_jHN8-eWDyCxpq1nbEiTYjBCPpTCJ_uFtdQ26hO90gsZFIwnSDW-EO8sJso9J1f1Dixx5D5XE05QWWTCmfrshD8HCNAm8yHm3KBQhomSSOjOmRFryV5ZVD0dK9Appt9-OSpYczVLtaEyMztKRORgWQ).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF18ueOb4Et9eKIPnP_018XyQ9vzTuiB3Tq7SX5mmEoW_th_IPQ5L6PYoDoj13DywI0P8Nj2TMJ7V-SKwc-dOrKj-waGRmsXd200kHnhwVHPytk4vGOFsauaxIyklBpbHBZjomjs0syxwqWRWdNO18YRXO3yBMvZnxNNG0N1cB9ur84CC9g4KhdRlOSPH3f8XMous5iQo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXWVvKWubDWnsPFgUnCSL_PllfcrvGFxlMnAVoCCNE7fQFvJ5DXtkKoXI2mTTEbHv9vTLj27hzEhuZa9R9loMBrhBtOdqcpRed9niDCzxRaLl_rAjKqAfaP00qW8LtmfRRsqDkGRq4yHpyaIHcRlzq5wM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF17jhh4W0GZIIoax0p1gMZlARm1Eizl2gSVkRQP9c0QMYBTiuzwzyTc9R1zWSV1DCxl9UNXobwHj7GHWJ-j8i1pRVF8zUCYClqrOQNCnDM0U-9TqZE0i0gEawNRH57sfbc-m3r5ZnuVvb8SM7Qv95inOUK7PIFq8r39-3XsIkrsXYGXI37FxIMOaWWnS_BmxbylTvvnh7GzSXOrPECNXUWA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF15GmeJ6sc2kivRRSe-NMu7e_etkp6e9EKJCZcxJPYtGhL9ua2Ta_A00Sekl3rTa61woyar1vOlSQqvCGwIuJohAv2kMc960xfMdQ3zUaSHq-kNHSriJvyo0y2RoRXlNQObV86MqP_QORBid2q2-fFtbusOEKoH981MgG1FRq-BwEln77YKubIFO_ng)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF13rwqEG3J2h-xF9F_jHN8-eWDyCxpq1nbEiTYjBCPpTCJ_uFtdQ26hO90gsZFIwnSDW-EO8sJso9J1f1Dixx5D5XE05QWWTCmfrshD8HCNAm8yHm3KBQhomSSOjOmRFryV5ZVD0dK9Appt9-OSpYczVLtaEyMztKRORgWQ)

To help tailor this information, are you asking about a **current episode** or **recurring symptoms** after drinking? Sharing **how much and how recently** alcohol was consumed, along with any **other symptoms** (like dizziness, chest discomfort, or anxiety), can also help.
